recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the original mapping clarification in current terminology without reopening FHIR-20396's later design decision or changing conformance behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-5743 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Questionnaire clarification asking for text that explains how AnswerFormat codes, including choice and open-choice, map to the datatype used in the corresponding QuestionnaireAnswer/QuestionnaireResponse answer.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in SVN revision 4164, now git commit 3ab829999c6c6e3d8e2b24997e33bf79f5b2a9e0, which added the Questionnaire notes Question types table mapping text, url, choice, and open-choice codes to answer datatypes.
additional_context: Questionnaire is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later R5 work in FHIR-20396 removed choice and open-choice from Questionnaire.item.type, added coding and answerConstraint, and updated this same table's data rows, so the remaining AnswerFormat table heading was stale relative to the current Questionnaire.item.type binding and item-type code system.
reconciliation: Changed source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml so the table heading reads Questionnaire item.type code, preserving the existing text/url/coding datatype mappings that already reflect the later R5 model.
source_changes: source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml: updated the Question types mapping table heading from obsolete AnswerFormat terminology to Questionnaire item.type.
